 This appeal coming on for admission this day, the court   following:
 ORDER
With the consent of the parties, the matter is heard finally at motion stage.

This appeal has been filed by the claimant/appellant under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 against the award dated 17.02.2023 passed in MACC.No.38/2016 9th Additional M.A.C.T.,
Rewa, District- Rewa, seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that Tribunal has determined deceased's monthly income as Rs.5,000/-., whereas, on the date of accident, minimum wages of an unskilled labour were Rs.5,939/- per month.
Therefore, compensation awarded by the Tribunal be suitably enhanced.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for respondent/Insurance Company submits that compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just & proper.
No enhancement is required.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
5. So far as income of deceased is concerned, on the date of accident, minimum wages of an unskilled labour were Rs.5,939/- per month.
Hence, deceased's monthly income is determined as Rs.5,939/- per month.
In view of age of deceased, 25% is to be added as future prospect, Multiplier of 15 is to be applied and in view of number of dependents, 1/3rd is to be deducted for personal and living expenses.
The appellants are entitled to receive Rs.15,000/- each for loss of estate and funeral expenses and Rs.40,000/- each for consortium.

6. Hence, in view of above, compensation awarded by Tribunal is recalculated as under:-
 S.No. Heads   1. Monthly Income of the appellant   2. Additional Future prospect 25% 
 3. Monthly loss of dependency (1/3rd) 
 4. Annual loss of dependency   6. Multiplier of 15  7. Compensation for loss of spousal/parental/filial Rs.1,60,000/-
consortium 9.

Compensation for loss of estate and towards Rs.30,000/-
funeral expenses 10.
Medical expenses Nil 11.

Total Compensation Rs.10,81,180/-
12.

Total compensation awarded by the Tribunal Rs.9,59,000/-
13.

Actual Enhancement Rs.1,22,180/-
7.

Hence, in view of above, including nature of injuries in the facts and circumstances of the case, it would be just and proper to enhance compensation by Rs.1,22,180/-
8.Enhanced compensation Rs.1,22,180/- shall carry interest at the rate awarded by the Tribunal.
Other findings of the Tribunal shall remain intact.
9.Appeal filed by the appellants is partly allowed to the extent as indicated above and dis- posed of accordingly.
